network.description: Pharos Atlas connects 200 specialist sources with stored representations in 10 languages and U.S. state, city, neighborhood and landmark navigation. Localized HTML and structured APIs are resource-specific. The 197 fixed English snapshots are separate purchases; coverage varies by source and route.

locale_contract.localized_source_content: Existing stored locale projections; non-English content may be machine-assisted and unreviewed. Consult each source provenance.

resource_selection.json: language query parameter only where documented

locale_contract.inventory_counting: Locale representations do not multiply the number of specialist sources or products.

selection.state: Exact canonical state slug from the 50-state registry; names and postal abbreviations are not selector IDs.
selection.deeper_levels: Follow returned source record IDs and canonical links; IDs are preserved across locales.

dataset.coverage: Pinned, uneven source inventory across 50 states. Excludes DC and territories; does not claim every US city, neighborhood or landmark.

source_id.meaning: R2 provenance-source ID, not a specialist site ID or domain

query.pagination: Follow response links.next until null. Manifest supports page 1 only.

availability.purchase_readiness: A route template or 402 response alone does not prove useful content is available. Invalid, missing or empty resources are not offered for purchase.
availability.omitted_records: An omitted record is not evidence that a place or service does not exist.

provenance.neighborhood_coordinate: City reference only; no separate neighborhood coordinate is provided.

locale_contract.localized_source_content: Existing stored locale projections; non-English content may be machine-assisted and unreviewed. Consult each source provenance.

resource_selection.json: language query parameter only where documented

locale_contract.inventory_counting: Locale representations do not multiply the number of specialist sources or products.

selection.state: Exact canonical state slug from the 50-state registry; names and postal abbreviations are not selector IDs.
selection.deeper_levels: Follow returned source record IDs and canonical links; IDs are preserved across locales.

dataset.coverage: Pinned, uneven source inventory across 50 states. Excludes DC and territories; does not claim every US city, neighborhood or landmark.

source_id.meaning: R2 provenance-source ID, not a specialist site ID or domain

query.pagination: Follow response links.next until null. Manifest supports page 1 only.

availability.source_catalog_and_sector_references: Master dataset only; follow returned links and availability. Contextual reference HTML requires a nonempty collection.
availability.source_taxonomy: Subject, intent, context and variable slugs must belong to the selected specialist source taxonomy.
availability.purchase_readiness: A route template or 402 response alone does not prove useful content is available. Invalid, missing or empty resources are not offered for purchase.
availability.omitted_records: An omitted record is not evidence that a place or service does not exist.

provenance.neighborhood_coordinate: City reference only; no separate neighborhood coordinate is provided.

atlas.answer_location: Optional text, trimmed to 80 characters in the legacy answer contract. A lowercase slug may be forwarded as state context; this does not guarantee a city, address or geospatial lookup.

source_collection_coverage.evidence_scope: Pinned source inventory and local renderer checks; not a paid-delivery audit of every resource, geography or language.

fixed_snapshot_collection.scope: Each named JSON snapshot is a separate fixed English product. Network language and location selection do not translate or change it.

network.purchase_scope: One exact existing resource and representation per purchase. Inspect its source, availability, MIME type, inputs and canonical quote. Missing or empty combinations are not purchase offers.
